release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.5.3 — Play Protect Fix & Welcome Flow Stability:
• Play Protect Warning Resolved: Completely removed high-risk NotificationListenerService, restoring trusted clean permission signature.
• Welcome Page Routing Guard: Prevented cold-launch redirection to quiz page. Users stay on welcome/onboarding until authentic study action begins.
• In-Foreground Guardian Protection: Guardian service now respects FocusDefend in-app foreground activity, completely eliminating false interceptions while using the app.
• 100% NCERT Rationalized Question Engine: 30,000 verified curriculum questions with strict class isolation.
• Streaming HTTP Distribution: Multi-threaded server with full byte-range resumable download support.
